title: The easiest way to build evals and custom benchmarks for real-world tasks
excerpt: Run eval experiments at scale in realistic environments on fully managed cloud infrastructure. Define custom task sets to build your private benchmarks, measure how well agents can use any product, and find best models for your use cases. Generate dynamic insights such as frictions in product interfaces or token inefficiencies.
content_html:
Run eval experiments at scale in realistic environments on fully managed cloud infrastructureDefine custom task sets to build your private benchmarks, measure how well agents can use any product, and find best models for your use cases. Generate dynamic insights such as frictions in product interfaces or token inefficiencies.

An interactive walkthrough of building and launching an agent experiment in Oqoqo: describing a task, selecting tasks, configuring agents, treatments, runs and evals, then launching runs on sandboxed machines and reviewing pass and fail results with full step-by-step trajectories.

Configure an experiment: tasks, agents, treatments, rubrics, and headless interfaces.
